BiblicalUsage: Mattattah is one of the sons of Hashum who had taken foreign wives. He put them away at Ezra's command after the return from exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single mention is enough: a man who obeyed a hard command is remembered, and the putting away of what God forbade is still the shape of repentance.
